_comment: Engagement / warming config for X, Pinterest, Instagram. Per-platform daily action budgets and time windows. Skills read this; the user edits it.

global._note: platform_rotation order is shuffled each run; this is the seed order. min_gap_minutes_between_platforms is enforced via state file timestamps.

x._skipped_reason: follow + comment are higher bot-detection signals; add later after graduating

pinterest._skipped_reason: Pinterest is more lenient than X/IG; follow is fine here. Comments still skipped.

instagram._skipped_reason: IG is the most aggressive about bot-detection signals; start with scroll + like only

jitter._comment: All durations are milliseconds. Use scripts/jitter.sh to sample.
